method.source_exception: User explicitly authorized proceeding with DraftKings instead of unavailable FanDuel data.
method.core_rule: CORE is an available alternate line with American odds between -350 and -150 inclusive, selected by odds closest to -250; tie -> more negative odds.
method.floor_rule: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than CORE.
method.ceiling_rule: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than CORE.
method.historical_hr: Count locked Stage 1 L10 observations strictly greater than the listed half-point line; denominator remains 10.
method.percentile_tiers: Tier 1 if target <= P7; Tier 2 if target > P7 and <= P16; Tier 3 if target > P16. Missing percentiles would be unclassified; none were missing here.
method.price_score: American odds converted to decimal odds and net return per unit stake; 0-100 min-max scaled within percentile tier across all available alternate lines in this Stage 2 snapshot; ties/all equal -> 50.
method.candidate_narrowing: Carry a player-market into Stage 3 if its best designated Floor/Core/Ceiling threshold is at least 8/10, OR its locked Stage 1 market HR is at least 6/10 and a valid CORE exists. For selection among bands, prioritize percentile tier, then HR, then CORE, then lower threshold. This is a transparent narrowing heuristic, not a new Stage 1 eligibility gate.
method.main_line_status: PROVISIONAL: Stage 1 source has no explicit main/alternate flag; preserve Stage 1 line as provisional and do not revise it.
